get.summary: List a vault's contacts

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text (LIKE match on the searchable columns).

parameters.name: listed
parameters.description: `true` for listed contacts, `false` for archived/unlisted ones.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
`last_updated`: `last_updated_at` newest first. `asc`/`desc`: by the
first name part of the user's `name_order` (e.g. `last_name`).
`first_name`: `first_name` then `last_name`, A to Z. `created_at`:
oldest first. Default: the user's `contact_sort_order`
(saved with PATCH /me/preferences).

template_id.description: Null until a template is chosen (R055).

oneOf.description: One of the account's address types.

linked to this contact) or the address fields (create one), not both.

address_type_id.description: One of the account's address types.

ContactCard.description:
A contact with what the hover card shows (today `ContactCardHelper`):
age and the groups the contact belongs to.

age.description:

date; null when there is none or it has no year.

listed.description: False for contacts hidden from lists (e.g. created via a relationship).

day), a day and month, or a year alone. The form's "I only know an age"

`social_protocols` prefix of ContactInformationModule.

`social_protocols` are the static tables of `config/app.php`.

url.description: Prefix put before `data`; empty when there is none (Mastodon).

protocol.description: Prefix that makes the value clickable, e.g. `mailto:`, `tel:`.

type.description:
Group: `email`, `phone` (one seeded type each, not deletable),
`IMPP` or `X-SOCIAL-PROFILE`.

date if it is after today (UTC), else its day and month this year

from the user's `name_order` and fetches the avatar separately.

listed.description: False for contacts hidden from lists (e.g. created via a relationship).

ContactUpdate.description:
Field groups and what they trigger:
names, `gender_id`, `pronoun_id` → UpdateContact (`last_updated_at`,
feed `information_updated`); `listed` → archive/unarchive
(`last_updated_at`, feed `archived`/`unarchived`); `is_favorite` → for
the current user (`last_updated_at`, feed `favorited`/`unfavorited`);
`show_quick_facts`; `template_id` (`last_updated_at`). A boolean equal
to the stored value changes nothing.

null when that object was deleted since (then `description` says what

`contact_information` for contact_information_*, `pet` for pet_*,
`note` for note_*, `goal` for goal_*, `mood_tracking_event` for
mood_tracking_event_*. Other actions carry no object.

can_be_deleted.description: False for the contact information page.

slug.description: Derived from the name; identifies the tab in contact page URLs.

type.description:
`contact_information` for the fixed page every template has
(the contact header: avatar, names, labels, …); null for the
other pages.

already_used.description: Computed. True when the module is already on this page.

pagination.description: Stored page size; set only on the seeded notes module and not read by any page today.

reserved_to_contact_information.description: True if the module can only go on the contact information page; false if it can only go on the other pages.

available_modules.description:
The account's modules that fit this page (see getTemplatePage),
ordered by `id`; the page sorts them by display name.

can_be_deleted.description: False for the contact information page.

modules.description: The modules on the page, ordered by `position`.

slug.description: Derived from the name; identifies the tab in contact page URLs.

type.description:
`contact_information` for the fixed page every template has
(the contact header: avatar, names, labels, …); null for the
other pages.

TemplatePageModule.description: An account module as placed on a template page.

pagination.description: Stored page size; set only on the seeded notes module and not read by any page today.

reserved_to_contact_information.description: True if the module can only go on the contact information page; false if it can only go on the other pages.

first_happened_at.description: Computed - earliest `happened_at` of its life events (the start of the range the UI shows).

last_happened_at.description: Computed - latest `happened_at` of its life events.

utc_offset.description: Computed. Current offset from UTC in minutes (the page shows it as `GMT/UTC - 03:00`).

UpcomingReminder.description: One scheduled occurrence of a contact reminder.

UserPreferences.description: The logged-in user's display and format preferences.

name_order.description: How contact names are built, e.g. `%first_name% %last_name%`.

UserSummary.description:
A user as other users see them; `contact` is the user's own contact in
the vault of the response, when there is one.

Vault.description: A vault, with the caller's permission and own contact in it.

permission.description: The caller's permission: 100 manager, 200 editor, 300 viewer.

user_contact_id.description: The caller's own contact in the vault.

current_date.description: Today in the user's timezone (default date of the mood form).

due_tasks.description:
Uncompleted tasks of the vault's contacts due within 30 days
(overdue included) or without a due date, by `due_at` (no date
first). Completing one is updateContactTask.

favorites.description: Contacts the current user marked favorite in this vault.

life_events.description: The life events module of the user's own contact in the vault.

life_metrics.description: The current year's life metrics, as listVaultLifeMetrics.

mood_tracking_parameters.description: For the mood form, by `position`. The form posts createContactMoodTrackingEvent on `Vault.user_contact_id`.

upcoming_reminders.description:
Untriggered reminders of the vault's contacts scheduled up to 30 days
from now (past untriggered ones included), by `scheduled_at`, one
per reminder.

user_contact.description:
The current user's own contact in the vault (`Vault.user_contact_id`):
the mood form and the life events module act on it, and the life
events form shows it as the first participant.

oneOf.description: The contact the file belongs to (photo, document or avatar), else null.

counts.description: Computed; files in the vault by type, ignoring `type`.

VaultFileListCounts.description: Computed; files in the vault by type, ignoring `type`.

contacts_count.description: All contacts of the vault, unlisted ones included.

contacts_sample.description: Up to 5 random contacts of the vault.

VaultTask.description: A contact task shown outside the contact page, with its contact.

author_id.description: Null when the author was deleted.

is_late.description: Computed - `due_at` (midnight UTC) is in the past, so a task due today is late; false without `due_at`.

WikipediaInfo.description: What the report pages show about a place.

bearerToken.description: Personal access token with abilities `read` and/or `write`.

sessionCookie.name: monica_session
sessionCookie.description: Browser session. Unsafe methods also need the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header equal to the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie.
